# AI Factory entry point

For repository-aware agent work, explicitly read root AGENTS.md before edits. Load the Factory ticket you are assigned (`python3 .factory2/factory.py ticket show TICKET_ID`) and the scoped instructions for affected paths. These references require file access; a Markdown mention alone does not load the target. If the current Copilot surface cannot read files or run commands, say so and provide proposals without claiming local execution. Preserve ticket/worktree ownership and existing authorization. Write project documents in English. Shared repository files define the full workflow.
